column3: 5 min light cardio, arm circles, hip circles, bodyweight squats

column4: Moderate weights, stop with 2-3 reps left in the tank
Add 2.5-5 kg (or 1-2 reps) when all sets are completed cleanly
Heavier loads, 1-2 reps left, finishers up to 20 min

column1: Deload: in weeks 4, 8 and 12, cut sets by about a third.

column2: Skip jumping, burpees and running for the first 6-8 weeks
Ask a trainer to check squat, deadlift and press form in week 1
Sharp joint pain means stop and modify the exercise
If dizzy or weak, cut a set or two and eat post-workout breakfast promptly
Get a quick check-up (BP, blood sugar, knees) before starting
